title: What equipment should you choose for jewelry photography?
h1: What equipment should you choose for jewelry photography? 📷
metaTitle: The essential equipment for jewelry photography 📷
description: Through these tutorials, discover the essentials for macro photography and jewelry photography for your e-commerce.
tool: An SLR camera, a macro lens, multi-source LED lighting, and a tripod
logistics: Someone on your team (and an Orbitvu photo studio)
introText:
To photograph jewelry, precious stones or timepieces, it is essential to use equipment specifically designed for macro photography. 💎

The aim : quickly obtain high-quality visuals that highlight multiple details, ornaments and textures, while ensuring a color rendering faithful to the original.

We reveal all our practical advice and tips from professionals in this complete tutorial, in order to master the art of photography of jewelry and precious objects.💍

‍

steps.title: Choose an SLR camera for your jewelry
steps.content:
📷 For macro photography of this type of room, opt for a SLR camera. There are two types of sensors for this range: APS-C and Full Frame sensors.

They are composed of photocells that capture light for each pixel in the image. The full format thus offers a better rendering of the image.
‍

🔍 Depending on your budget, it's up to you to find the balance between camera and lens. There are very good entry-level SLR cameras with APS-C sensor (Canon EOS 800D).

For full-frame sensors, the entry model is the Canon EOS 6D Mark II, followed by the 5D Mark IV.

steps.title: Macro lenses: essential for your jewelry photos
steps.content:
🔍 Choose a macro lens with a fixed focus. This type of lens is much more sensitive to light and offers a better quality rendering than a zoom lens.

The ideal focal length is 100 mm, with a large aperture (F2.8) and a ratio of 1 to 1 to 1 to visually restore the object photographed to its real size.

📷 There are good affordable macro lenses dedicated to SLR cameras (Canon EF-S range) and full frame SLR cameras (Canon EF range). Count between 300 and 800 euros.‍

steps.title: The photo tripod: find the right compromise
steps.content:
Finally, equip yourself with a quality tripod. It is essential for stabilizing your camera and maintaining focus.

Since the diaphragm is often very closed, the tolerance to movements is therefore zero. Several major brands offer quality tripods: Manfrotto, Gitzo or even Vanguard.
‍

Choosing an aluminum tripod allows a good compromise between stability, weight and price. Carbon fiber is driving prices up a notch and plastic tripods are clearly to be banned due to their poor quality.

✨ Alternative solution : the specialized accessory, the Orbitvu Column Stand. This custom tripod with ball joint system is adjustable in height and distance thanks to a rail system. The ball joint also allows the device to be tilted degree by degree.‍

steps.title: Opt for continuous, multi-source and point source lighting
steps.content:
💡 When it comes to photographing your jewelry, quality lighting plays a key role. For example, you will avoid unwanted shadows and reflections, while providing a faithful rendering of colors and materials.

For this, a multi-source LED lighting with adjustable intensity is ideal. It has a color rendering index (CRI) greater than 90.

💻 On a lightbox studio controlled by software, modulate its intensity over several ranges. The beach, which is around 3000°K, offers a warm finish, ideal for taking photos of gold jewelry. Between 5000 and 6500°K, the intensity corresponds to daylight.

This temperature provides a natural look perfect for revealing small details such as ornaments or engravings.

💎The lighting says punctual is a direct light beam that can be moved around the piece of jewelry to complement fixed lighting. It is particularly useful for obtaining quality lighting on gemstones that are difficult to illuminate.‍

faqs.question: How can you ensure that the details engraved on a piece of jewellery are crystal clear?
faqs.answer: To capture etched details, use an intermediate aperture (between f/8 and f/11) to maximize depth of field and a tripod to stabilize the camera. Soft side lighting can also improve the visibility of the prints.

faqs.question: Do I need to clean the macro lens regularly?
faqs.answer: Yes, macro lenses are sensitive to micro dust that can affect image sharpness, especially when shooting jewelry in high resolution. Regular cleaning with a microfiber cloth is recommended.

faqs.question: How does an automated packshot studio and a suitable camera reduce production costs?
faqs.answer: By combining an automated packshot studio and a suitable SLR camera, you optimize the capture, background removal and assembly of images. This reduces errors, limits rework, and decreases labor costs, all while making products go online faster.

faqs.question: Is it possible to capture several jewels in a single shot?
faqs.answer: Yes, using a packshot studio with the right lighting setup, you can shoot multiple pieces of jewelry simultaneously. However, it is important to check that each room is well lit and highlighted.

faqs.question: What is the best distance between the lens and the jewelry for a macro photo?
faqs.answer: The optimal distance depends on the focal length of the lens, but for a 100mm macro lens, a distance of 30-50cm is ideal for capturing details without distortion or loss of sharpness.
